# Vendored files

`axe.min.js` is the accessibility engine **axe-core 4.14.0** by Deque Systems, copied unchanged from the npm package `axe-core`
(licence: MPL-2.0, see `axe-core-LICENSE.txt`). The tests inject it into the page and run it, the way the Playwright and Cypress
projects use it, so all three scan the same rules.
